title: Dakota Johnson to Star in and Produce Tell Me Everything
excerpt:
Lionsgate acquired the relationship dramedy in a competitive spec sale.
Johnson will portray a cynical divorce attorney.
body_md:
Dakota Johnson is attached to star in and produce Tell Me Everything for Lionsgate. The studio secured the screenplay following a competitive sale involving multiple offers.

The story follows a celebrity therapist experiencing marital difficulties who meets Johnson's character, a divorce attorney who has lost faith in love. Their unexpected connection challenges both women's assumptions about relationships and commitment.

Conceived as a contemporary relationship dramedy, the film contrasts two professions closely connected to intimate relationships. One character helps people navigate emotional difficulties, while the other deals professionally with the dissolution of marriages.

Gaelyn Golde, who wrote Netflix's upcoming Saturn Return, penned the screenplay and will executive produce. Johnson will produce alongside Ro Donnelly, with Samantha Racanelli producing for TeaTime Pictures.

A director, additional casting, production schedule and release date have not been announced. The acquisition and Johnson's involvement are the confirmed developments at this stage.
